reviews.name: Cole Untiedt
reviews.text: SYB has the best active, group travel in the game! Just book it and go, they cover ALLLL the details. I recently traveled with them to Belize and it was amazing! Great, curated group of individuals and nice accommodations. Some highlights of the trip included the neon yoga, along with swimming with local nurse sharks. If you are seeking an active, action packed trip - look no further! 🌴

reviews.name: Hunter F
reviews.text: Had an amazing experience. As soon as I got back from my trip to France, I booked another trip to Belize in the fall. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Ely Goldberg
reviews.text:
I have now been on two incredible Surf Yoga Beer trips and all I can say is wow! Just spent a week in Belize in December, and I’m still riding the high from it and have already booked my next trip. I’ve traveled a lot, but these trips feel different in the best way; more connected, more intentional, and honestly more fun than I expected. Both Belize and my NYE last year in Nicaragua were both 10/10!!

What stood out most wasn’t just the beautiful beaches or the balance of planned activities, but the people. On both trips the group energy was unreal. Everyone showed up open, supportive, and ready to make the most of every moment. By the end of the week, it felt like we’d known each other forever.

The leaders also deserve a huge shoutout, Mantas, Steph, Courtney, Sam, Eli, Duncan, Allison, Sav, Shriner and Matas and so many more across both trips. They set the tone from day one: warm, organized, and genuinely invested in making sure every single person had an amazing experience. They’re the kind of people who make you want to show up as your best self.

Every day had its own magic, whether it was sunrise workouts, exploring Caye Caulker, standing up on a surfboard for the first time ever, or laughing over dinner after a full day of adventure. And, of course, the big highlight each trip were the multiple boat days!!

If you’re thinking about booking a Surf Yoga Beer trip, just do it. The destinations are incredible, but it’s the community and the leadership that make it unforgettable. I left feeling inspired, recharged, and genuinely grateful for all the people I met.

reviews.name: Kim Keith
reviews.text: I just completed my second solo SYB trip in Belize and I am in awe of such another unforgettable experience. From the stay to the itinerary, the company goes above and beyond to make sure everyone is comfortable - and has an absolute blast! Special shoutout to our leader Sav who put together some of the most fun workouts I've ever done! Also incredibly grateful to our other leaders on the trip Shriner, Marisa, & Matas who made the trip that much more memorable for everyone. I can't wait for my next SYB trip!

reviews.name: Florian Strambu
reviews.text: Went on the Belize trip in December. SYB brought it back for the first time since 2019. It was amazing. Snorkeling, scuba, boat days, delicious meals, beaches, 85 degrees everyday, great people. This trip has the potential to become one of their best. I would highly recommend Belize to anyone looking to re-balance and grow their community of like minded people. Just do it!

reviews.name: Blair Bou-Chebl
reviews.text: I just got back from my first trip with SYB in Belize and cannot recommend it highly enough! I was a little nervous as a first-time solo traveler, but the leaders did a great job of bringing everyone together and setting the tone for the next few days of community. Our accommodations were awesome--beautiful beach-front property and helpful staff. I super enjoyed the balance of activities and down time on the beach, so it was a perfect vacation from the real world/winter. I left with so many new like-minded friends, and I can't wait to sign up for my next adventure!
